title: Concept: Anchor element uses the javascript: scheme
description: An anchor with a javascript: href runs its code in the page origin when clicked and only works while inline script is permitted. The sink is a direct cross-site scripting primitive as soon as a template interpolates a value into it.
risk: If a template ever interpolates a request value into the URL, one click executes attacker script in the authenticated origin; the sink also forces script-src to keep allowing inline script.
